title: Pan-Seared Bass with Light Oceanic Soup
description: A light and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared bass served with a refreshing oceanic soup.
instructions: 1. Season bass fillets with sea salt and Kenyan sea salt.
2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add bass fillets to the skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes per side.
4. Remove bass from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add diced Kenyan tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes.
6. Add light oceanic soup broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
7. Reduce heat to low and let soup simmer for 5-7 minutes.
8. Serve pan-seared bass with light oceanic soup.
9. Garnish with chopped parsley and a sprig of fresh basil.
